local function edit_distance(a, b)
    local table_values = {}
    for i = 0, #a do table_values[i] = {[0] = i} end
    for j = 0, #b do table_values[0][j] = j end
    for i = 1, #a do
        for j = 1, #b do
            local cost = a:sub(i, i) == b:sub(j, j) and 0 or 1
            table_values[i][j] = math.min(table_values[i - 1][j] + 1, table_values[i][j - 1] + 1,
                table_values[i - 1][j - 1] + cost)
        end
    end
    return table_values[#a][#b]
end

local word_pairs = {
    {"kitten", "sitting"}, {"flaw", "lawn"}, {"listen", "silent"}, {"intention", "execution"},
    {"algorithm", "altruistic"},
}
for _, pair in ipairs(word_pairs) do
    io.write(string.format("%s -> %s: %d\n", pair[1], pair[2], edit_distance(pair[1], pair[2])))
end
